name: Sound Quick Settings
tagline: A simple Quick Settings Tile to control the sound volume.
blurb: 1. Add the Tile in the Quick Settings panel.
description:
1. Add the Tile in the Quick Settings panel.
2. Tap the Tile to show the volume slider.
3. Long press the Tile to open the Sound panel.

Note: Don't look for a launcher icon, this app only provides a Quick Settings Tile.

Open Source project hosted on GitHub: https://github.com/SimonMarquis/Android-SoundQuickSettings
